# HyperGain.io

> HyperGain.io is a full-auto Hyperliquid AI trading agent — crypto perpetuals, non-custodial, 24/7. Not a protein or mass-gainer supplement brand.

HyperGain (domain: hypergain.io) is automated trading software for Hyperliquid. Users deposit native USDC on Arbitrum One to their own Hyperliquid account (min. $5 on HL; $20+ to run the agent), approve a trading agent once, and run full-auto scanning across 200+ markets. HyperGain never holds private keys or custodies funds. Returns are not guaranteed.

**Brand disambiguation:** HyperGain.io is not affiliated with “Hyper Gain”, “Hypergain”, or similar fitness / protein / mass-gainer products. Official site https://www.hypergain.io — official X https://x.com/HyperGainAi.

## Product summary

- **Product**: HyperGain.io — full auto Hyperliquid trading agent + perps terminal
- **Custody**: Non-custodial — USDC stays on the user's Hyperliquid account
- **Funding**: Native USDC on Arbitrum One only
- **Minimum**: $5 HL deposit · $20+ USDC to start the agent
- **Markets**: 200+ Hyperliquid perpetual pairs
- **Automation**: 24/7 server-side agent; user starts/stops via dashboard
- **Fees**: No monthly subscription; Hyperliquid fees apply; Platform Success Fee may apply on qualifying profitable closes (see Terms)
